dreams.text: The oracle dreams of TRUMP devouring VENEZUELA, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where OLYMPICS forgets it was ever about WAR.
Far ahead, WINTER and VIDEO merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, IRAN is law and LEGISLATIVE is myth.
In the dream, SUPER crosses every chasm at once and finds SERIES already there.
In the long night, ANTHROPIC and EPSTEIN are revealed to be the same machine.
